The newly added template app/views/embed/best.html.erb contains nontrivial branching (`if @topic_view.posts.present?` / else) and renders fields like `post.user.small_avatar_url`, `post.user.username`, and `raw post.cooked`, but no test in the diff renders the view with real `@topic_view` data to cover those branches (including the zero-posts case). This is a concrete test coverage gap introduced alongside new embed view behavior, not a directly verifiable runtime bug from the diff alone.
